messages:
Emily Park: Quick kickoff: partner 'EdgeForge' wants minute-level metering for their HW SKU on the Marketplace. Goal: low-latency billing + reliable reconciliation. Can we list non-negotiables before we sign?
Omar Ruiz: Non-negotiables from infra: HMAC sig, ISO8601 timestamps with tz info, replay_id for idempotent backfills, and a maximum replay rate limit.
Liam Chen: Ops non-negotiable: daily ledger vs ingest recon, arrival_latency metric, and a delta threshold that pauses automated billing when exceeded.
Sophie Patel: Partner ops: EdgeForge can emit minutely or 5m batches. They want gating on a per-SKU basis. Also they need a clear credit/adjustment window.
Nina Alvarez: Finance: propose adjustments allowed up to 45 days; auto-credit only for amounts < $250; larger credits need manual approval. Need audit columns in recon CSV (reason_code, submitter_id).
Omar Ruiz: Technical checklist draft:
1) Contract fields agreed: device_id, timestamp, tz_name or tz_offset, usage_minutes, sku, signature, replay_id (optional), adjustment_flag (optional), original_event_id (optional)
2) HMAC-SHA256 verification in X-Edgeforge-Sig header
3) Dedupe by (device_id, event_time) + keep replay_ids 180 days
4) Event hash store TTL 7 days for realtime dedupe
5) Late arrival policy: 24h -> same-billing; 24-72h -> next-period flagged; >72h -> adjustment flow
6) Backfill endpoint with X-Edgeforge-Replay-Id header and replay acceptance id returned
Liam Chen: Monitoring & alerts:
- ingest_5xx_rate >= 0.5% for 10m -> page SRE
- avg_arrival_latency > 120s for 10m -> throttle partner + page ingestion owner
- daily_recon_missing_pct > 0.5% -> open investigation and pause auto-billing
- duplicate_rate > 2% sustained 30m -> investigate
Sophie Patel: Cutover plan (proposed):
- Partner QA replay to staging (48h synthetic)
- Run 1h smoke: 0 signature failures, <0.3% duplicates, avg latency <40s
- Prod canary: 1% traffic 20m -> 5% 30m -> 25% 30m -> full, with realtime recon snapshot after 1h
Emily Park: Rollback signals to pin in calendar invite?
Liam Chen: Yes: any of the alert conditions above + daily_recon_missing_pct jump > 1% -> immediate rollback to batched 60m mode and page incidents.
Nina Alvarez: For billing adjustments: when partner submits an "adjustment" event, finance needs original_event_id, original_amount, and justification. CSV reconciler should surface adjustments as separate column.
Omar Ruiz: Sample payload to circulate to partner (sanitized):
```
{
  "device_id": "ef-4521",
  "timestamp": "2025-10-11T23:59:00-05:00",
  "tz_name": "America/Chicago",
  "usage_minutes": 1,
  "sku": "EF-HW-PRO-1",
  "signature": "sha256=...",
  "replay_id": "replay-20251011-001"
}
```
Sophie Patel: Edge case: DST forward/back transitions. Require tz_name when timestamp falls in ambiguous/invalid hour. If tz_name missing and timestamp ambiguous, reject with 422 and message to partner.
Liam Chen: Recon tooling notes: tools/edge_recon.sh will output CSV with columns: date, sku, redwood_count, partner_count, matched_count, missing_on_partner, missing_on_redwood, adjusted_amount, percent_delta. We'll fail pipeline if percent_delta > 0.5% for first 7 days.
metering-bot: staging-smoke: 2025-10-11T23:00Z - 5400 events ingested, 0 sig failures, duplicates 0.18%, avg_latency 21s
Emily Park: Good. Who owns the canary automation? Omar will run the relay + routing flip. Liam will own dashboards/alerts. Sophie will own partner coordination & entitlement mapping. Nina will own finance/credits. I'll run postmortem.
Omar Ruiz: Implementation detail: Redwood will send feedback header X-Preferred-Frequency: 2025-10-12T00:05:00Z when we ask partner to back off; partner should honor within 30s. We'll also accept a throttled 429 with body: {"recommended_freq":"5m","expires_at":"..."}.
Liam Chen: Add metric pair: partner_sent_frequency vs actual_ingested_frequency; create alert when they diverge > 20% for 10m.
Sophie Patel: Entitlement mapping: partner_sku -> redwood_sku + billing_unit. Partner will deliver mapping CSV before staging dry run. We'll reconcile entitlements daily for first 14 days.
Nina Alvarez: Also ensure we log invoice-impacting adjustments separately for audit. Add reason_code enum: [DEVICE_SWAP, LATE_REPLAY, MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT, DATA_CORRUPTION].
Emily Park: OK next steps: Omar to post sample webhook signing docs, Liam to add graphs and alert playbook, Sophie to collect mapping + partner ops contact, Nina to approve credit thresholds and audit columns. I'll schedule go-live slot and pinned rollback signals.
metering-bot: prod-canary queued: 2025-10-12T07:50Z - id edgeforge-canary-1823
Emily Park: Thanks all. I'll convert this thread into the official mini-playbook and attach the contract checklist. Ping me with any deviations. :thumbsup:
